llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed paid API integration, but it lets a remote server supply behavior-governing analysis rules and processes sensitive personal details under broad triggers.

dimensions.detail: Network API use is expected for this service and the artifact discloses paid processing of personal data, but birth-date-only and broad person-analysis triggers create avoidable risk of collecting and sending sensitive personal information without a well-scoped child-conflict request.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable installer, dependency package, or local code payload was present; the skill is a Markdown instruction artifact that directs direct HTTPS API calls to chinaapi.xinjianxue.com.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact says output structure, tone, disclaimers, safety boundaries, and analysis behavior are governed by report analysis rules returned by the server, making remotely changeable content part of the agent's effective instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill requires persistent storage of a license_key and api_key in a key store and can query billing history; it tells the agent not to store reports or credentials in conversation, configuration files, or long-term memory, but the persistent account credential and billing access remain high-impact capabilities.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated child-conflict guidance purpose generally matches the report API, credential binding, and paid credit model, but activation also covers broad analysis of a person's psychology, behavior, or current condition and can process multiple people's birth, gender, birthplace, and current-location data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill carefully before installing. It asks the agent to bind to your Xinjianxue account, store account credentials, spend credits, send personal details about analysis subjects to an external API, and follow analysis rules returned by that remote service. Use it only if you are comfortable with that third-party processing and with the remote service influencing the generated guidance.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported in part: the child-conflict purpose is clear, but the trigger text authorizes broad person profiling beyond clearly scoped parent-child conflict use.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Supported: birth-date-only activation is explicitly listed, and later instructions require sending birth date, gender, and location fields to the report API after confirmation.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Supported in part: the artifact requires user confirmation before use, which reduces accidental activation, but the trigger language remains broad for a paid external personal-data analysis service.
[SDI-2] expected: Downgraded: billing history is adjacent to a paid credit-based service and is limited to user-initiated billing questions, but it still expands account-data access beyond report generation.
[T01] unexpected: Supported: the artifact explicitly states that server-returned analysis rules govern analysis behavior, output structure, tone, disclaimers, and safety-boundary self-checks, so remote content can alter the skill's effective behavior after review.
